subject: Annual penetration test — scheduling windows & sandbox access
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@pentestco.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-ops@pentestco.com
Date: 2026-05-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Annual pen test availability and SOW v3

Hi Priyom,

Hope youre doing well. Attaching SOW_v3 for the annual pen test. Wed like to lock a test window — our team is available the weeks of June 7-11 or June 21-25. Please let us know which week you prefer and any blackout dates we should avoid.

Two quick operational notes:
- Well need sandbox access with a jump host (ephemeral credentials preferred).
- Well request a short-lived SSO test account (SAML) for user-level checks; if thats not possible, a scoped local account is acceptable.

Attachment: Pentest_SOW_v3.docx (docx)

If you have redlines in the SOW, send them back in-track and well respond within 48 hours.

Cheers,
Olivia Hart
Engagement Lead, PentestCo
olivia.hart@pentestco.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@pentestco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test availability and SOW v3

Thanks Olivia— appreciate the quick turnaround on the SOW.

Were leaning toward the week of June 21-25. We have a production freeze planned for June 8-18, so the earlier window will be risky for us. Confirming the following constraints so your ops team can plan:

- All testing must target the staging/sandbox VPC. No testing in prod.
- We can provide an ephemeral jump host and a scoped service account for the duration of testing; keys must be rotated after the engagement.
- Log access: we can provide read-only access to the consolidated ELK indices for the sandbox environment; no writes.
- Please provide a list of outbound IPs and a proposed daily time block (e.g., 09:00-17:00 local) so we can create temporary firewall rules.

Ive attached our environment-access-checklist (see Marissas note below for the internal owner). Also, a couple of SOW redlines well need handled before signing: a) clarifying data destruction timelines for sandbox artifacts, and b) liability cap language for non-production testing — our legal team will propose language next week.

Next steps:
1) Pick June 21-25 if that works for you.
2) Send IP list, SSO test account requirements, and expected duration for background scans.
3) Well prepare the temporary network exemptions once we have the IPs and exact time windows.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Luke Ramos <luke@ironrootsec.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test availability and SOW v3

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks for the details. A few clarifications from our ops side:

- Jump host: we prefer an ephemeral bastion in your sandbox VPC with outbound-only NAT for callbacks. We'll provide the public key material and remove our keys at the end of each day.
- Long-running background jobs: well avoid aggressive load tests unless explicitly authorized; please flag any cron jobs youre worried about.
- Logs: read-only ELK is fine; can you confirm retention window for the sandbox logs? We typically pull 30 days of context.
- SSO: a SAML test account is ideal. If you can create one that maps to "sandbox-pen-test@redwood.com" with limited entitlements, that will speed up auth testing.

Attachment: access-playbook.pdf (pdf)

Well draft a short test plan and circulate by June 7 per Priyoms timeline.

Regards,
Luke Ramos
Principal Tester, IronRoot Security
luke@ironrootsec.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Luke Ramos <luke@ironrootsec.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test availability and SOW v3

Looping in environment owner and attaching the checklist.

- Attached: environment-access-checklist.xlsx (xlsx) — this has the fields we need filled out (IP allowlist, SSH key exchange process, SSO test-account TTL, and log index patterns).
- Sandbox log retention: 45 days by default for sandbox ELK; we can increase to 90 days for the engagement if requested (note: storage costs).
- Canary test: we can reserve June 21 09:00-17:00 for a light canary run; please make the plan for that window and well validate safe limits.

Marissa
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone  consolidated confirmation below and a couple of items for legal/ops before we lock the SOW.

Confirmed:
- Test week: June 21-25 (full-week engagement).
- Canary window: June 21, 09:00-17:00 (light scans only).
- Access: ephemeral bastion in sandbox VPC; read-only ELK indices for sandbox; SAML test account sandbox-pen-test@redwood.com (TTL 7 days).
- Attachments: Pentest_SOW_v3.docx, environment-access-checklist.xlsx (please complete the checklist by June 7).

Open items (legal/ops):
1) SOW redlines: Legal will propose specific data-destruction language and a revision to the liability cap. Ive ccd Neha for legal follow-up.
2) Vendor deliverables: Please provide the full test plan by June 7 and a high-level daily schedule by June 14.
3) IPs/firewall: Send the allowlist at least 5 business days before the engagement.

Olivia, Luke  if the test plan and IP list hit those dates we can sign the SOW w/ a narrow amendment covering the redlines rather than re-issuing a full SOW. Please acknowledge and well have Nehas team draft the amendment for signatures.
